video_title: Cam'ron & The Kid Mero GET INTO IT over Wemby's physicality 👀 | First Take

quotes.speaker: Charles Barkley
quotes.summary_phrase: Charles Barkley criticizes the Knicks for not involving Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: they didn't use KAT at all tonight. 11 points on four of 10 shooting.
quotes.quote: I think the Knicks are reverting back to the way they played, too much Jalen Brunson eccentric. When they were winning, when they were blowing out teams, they were getting Karl-Anthony Towns involved more. To me, because KAT, they didn't use KAT at all tonight. 11 points on four of 10 shooting. They didn't use him, but I think they're becoming a little too Brunson-centric.

quotes.speaker: Cam'ron
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam'ron argues the Knicks need to run their offense through Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: have KAT as more of a facilitator, point forward big man and have Jalen Brunson be the closer.
quotes.quote: When Jalen Brunson dominates the ball like that and the other team plans for it, it's evident. When you have the Dominican Nikola Jokic on your team, you utilize him like that. They need to have KAT as more of a facilitator, point forward big man and have Jalen Brunson be the closer. He really is the closer.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith and Cam'ron debate if Jalen Brunson is to blame for the loss
quotes.excerpt: I think that Mike Brown has to lock in and stick to the game plan.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: Do I think it's Jalen Brunson's fault? No. I think that Mike Brown has to lock in and stick to the game plan. Even if Jalen Brunson is dribbling too much, you have to reel him in and let him know, look, we need to run this through Karl-Anthony Towns.

text_blocks.speaker: Cam'ron
text_blocks.text: Jalen Brunson has more turnovers than assists right now. When you have 12 assists and 13 turnovers in a series, it's a problem. So I'm not going to put that on Jalen Brunson, I'm going to put that on Mike Brown, but I do think it's a problem and the offense does need to be run through Karl-Anthony Towns.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins says Mike Brown was outcoached in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown just got outcoached. It's not Jalen Brunson's fault.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown just got outcoached. It's not Jalen Brunson's fault. They had a game plan. And I know we keep harping on like Karl-Anthony Towns has to get more involved, but what is the context behind it? Because they guarded him differently. Victor Wembanyama was not on him. They had a smaller defender, Victor Wembanyama was roaming, so he was disrupting a whole lot.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith defends his right to criticize Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: You can recognize and appreciate the greatness of Jalen Brunson and then also recognize when he's coming up short.
quotes.quote: You can recognize and appreciate the greatness of Jalen Brunson and then also recognize when he's coming up short in that department on a game-by-game basis. You know I love my soap operas. I keep trying to tell y'all, if it's General Hospital, Sunny Corinths, I mean he's been shot, been stabbed, been beat up the whole bit. You're young and restless, it's Victor Newman, you've been pushed down the stairs, you've been stabbed, you've been kidnapped, you got all this other stuff. They're going to live. They're going to be back in those stories. It doesn't stop you from chronicling the story as it unfolds.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero discusses Victor Wembanyama's physicality in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: if the officials allow Victor Wembanyama to be Conor McGregor, like he's been doing, I think we have some B-roll.
quotes.quote: Yeah, they can do that if the officials allow Victor Wembanyama to be Conor McGregor, like he's been doing. I think we have some B-roll to back this up. He's being, I mean listen, he's a superstar, so you're allowed to be physical if you're a superstar. But this is another level of physicality. If this happens in the park at a ShopRite, we're fighting. This is egregious. And it's the whole team, it's not just Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins dismisses the Knicks' complaints about officiating
quotes.excerpt: it's self-inflicted wounds. You show me the tape. We can pull up clips where the Knicks are getting physical.
quotes.quote: It's self-inflicted wounds. No, no, no, no, no. We can pull up clips where the Knicks are getting physical with them as well. We can pull up clips in Game 1 and Game 2 and just go watch an action. It's called horns, okay? And just watch Victor Wembanyama trying to roll to the basket. That's your assignment for the next two days. Text me and tell me what you see.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith explains how the Knicks can neutralize Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: if you can find a way to neutralize the pieces around him to make sure a guy like De'Aaron Fox ain't pulling up.
quotes.quote: Because if you can find a way to neutralize the pieces around him to make sure a guy like De'Aaron Fox ain't pulling up for Jalen Brunson in the lane with 12 seconds left, or you've got a Stefan Castle who is in a pest defensively and you're able to exploit him to some degree, or Dylan Harper that ain't coming off the bench and wreaking havoc for you. If you're able to neutralize those things from being as effective as they've been, then even if Victor Wembanyama gets his, it still ain't enough. It's not enough against this New York Knicks team.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith warns the Knicks about the dangers of losing Game 4
quotes.excerpt: New York needs to win tomorrow night because you don't want to give these young bloods the notion.
quotes.quote: New York needs to win tomorrow night because you don't want to give these young bloods the notion, yo, we figured them out. It's a problem. A 2-2 series, San Antonio reclaims home-court advantage, plus they go back for Game 5 with the momentum. New York needs to win tomorrow night because you don't want to give these young bloods the notion, yo, we figured them out.
